headline: AMD to Acquire AI Chip Firm Taalas for $2.9 Billion
summary: Advanced Micro Devices is set to pay $2.9 billion to acquire California-based artificial intelligence chip company Taalas in one of the largest Canadian tech takeovers.
why: Semiconductor acquisitions highlight intense industry competition and strategic consolidation in hardware capabilities required for AI infrastructure workloads.

impacts.name: Advanced Micro Devices
impacts.why: AMD deploys capital to acquire Taalas, directly expanding its proprietary AI chip portfolio.
